adequacy.rule: FACULTY 2026-10-28: adequate oxygen availability for lactate production means effective_oxygen_deficit == 0, so ADEQUATE and COMPENSATED both count as adequate; CRITICAL means effective_oxygen_deficit > 0. Lactate clearance does not require a return to normal resting DO2. Recorded for the future FD-LAC interpretation; faculty_constraints.adequate stays frozen until the lactate rebuild, which must read this rule. No lactate filter runs here.

boundary.stop: tau 240 survives: TAU_REMAINS_OPEN_AT_240; nothing above 240 is added without a faculty decision

policy: Frozen blood_constraints readings and passes(); FD-BLD-04, 05 and 06 and P2I-2Z's robust criterion unchanged. Design F0 0.20 x Finf {0.05, 0.10} x tau {120, 150, 180, 210, 240}; nothing above 240. The tau -> infinity limit is REFERENCE_ONLY. Adequacy (deficit == 0), the lactate rates and the L3 status are recorded, not applied. Trajectories and structural checks are context and filter nothing. No lactate filter runs; no lactate value, legacy trajectory, SBP or MAP is a target.

practical.rule: Structural: for an active point (Finf < F0) tau sets how fast the transient leaves, so it reaches every retained reading (STRUCTURALLY_IDENTIFIABLE); with Finf == F0 it is inert (reference only). Practical, within the 120-min horizon and against the faculty constraints: if tau is closed inside the tested domain, CONSTRAINT_BOUNDED_WITHIN_TESTED_DOMAIN. If tau 240 survives, every reading must be monotone in tau over the tested values (else NON_MONOTONE_UNRESOLVED); then the tau -> infinity limit (no transient) decides: if it passes FD-BLD-04, 05 and 06 at every key in both cases, no constraint can tell tau >= 240 apart (CONSTRAINT_INDISTINGUISHABLE_BEYOND_240) and the surviving range propagates as uncertainty bracketed by tau 240 and the limit; if the limit fails one, a finite constraint bound lies beyond 240, untested (CONSTRAINT_BOUNDED_BEYOND_TESTED_DOMAIN). Nothing is called identified because a point fails.
practical.structural: STRUCTURALLY_IDENTIFIABLE (Finf < F0); STRUCTURALLY_NON_IDENTIFIABLE when Finf == F0

rates.rule: FACULTY 2026-10-28: the future lactate space keeps 2.5 (it survived the blood-state faculty constraints in P2I-2V-R), 5 and 6 (tested viable, P2I-2X / P2I-2Y); 7 is the first tested jointly non-viable rate. No rate is approved; the lactate filter may reject one, nothing pre-eliminates it.
